findings.desc: agent:"lattice-review-concept" packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:429-456 implements closeout phase deadlines with Promise.race/setTimeout, but real wrapped closeout work still runs synchronously: git() uses execFileSync at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:199-204, runtimeChange calls synchronous git diff/comment scans at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:679-686, and cleanTree calls synchronous git status/classification at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1167-1174. While one of those synchronous operations is blocked, Node cannot run the timeout or heartbeat callbacks, so a real hung git/status/diff child can still outlive the phase deadline instead of failing closed by the independent deadline required by CHK-002/M2. The smoke only proves an async pending-promise injection at packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:321-331, so it does not cover the real synchronous closeout hang path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 9d9cf06430: done_prepare closeout phases now install a bounded child_process.execFileSync deadline wrapper for each heartbeating phase, restore it in finally, and the smoke covers a synchronous git hang failing closed before the global idle timeout.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:449 starts the closeout work in the same event-loop turn and line 455 relies on Promise.race for the phase deadline. The wrapped production phases still call synchronous helpers such as execFileSync-backed git at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:199 and runtime/clean-tree phase work at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1157 and packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1167. While any of those synchronous calls is blocked, the timeout callback cannot run, so a hung git/filesystem closeout can outlive LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_PHASE_TIMEOUT_MS and fall back to the global idle watchdog instead of the promised independent hard deadline. The smoke only injects an async pending promise at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:424, so it does not cover this real synchronous failure mode.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 9d9cf06430: done_prepare closeout phases now install a bounded child_process.execFileSync deadline wrapper for each heartbeating phase, restore it in finally, and the smoke covers a synchronous git hang failing closed before the global idle timeout.

findings.desc: done_prepare closeout hard deadlines are incomplete: installCloseoutPhaseChildProcessDeadline only replaces childProcess.execFileSync and syncs that named export, but the wrapped DONE-closure phase calls buildDoneClosureRunbook, which reaches execSync-based git probes such as readGitStatusLines (git status) and checkMainDivergence (git rev-list). A hung execSync blocks the event loop, prevents the Promise.race timeout/heartbeat from firing, and is never converted to DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError, so the phase can hang past its configured hard deadline. Patch execSync as well or convert these DONE-closure git probes to the bounded execFileSync path, and add smoke coverage for an execSync git hang.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 3f8c62469: done_prepare closeout phase deadline wrapper now patches both execFileSync and execSync, restores both in finally, syncs builtin ESM exports, and the focused smoke covers a doneClosure execSync git hang failing closed under the phase deadline.

findings.desc: agent:"lattice-review-concept" The post-validation done_prepare progress and JSON side-channel contract is present, but the hard-deadline concept is still incomplete for the real DONE-closure path. runCloseoutPhase installs a deadline wrapper only for childProcess.execFileSync at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:502-559, while the wrapped DONE-closure phase calls buildDoneClosureRunbook at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1246-1258. That runbook reaches execSync-backed git probes: checkMainDivergence uses git rev-list via execSync at packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:66-75 and readGitStatusLines uses git status via execSync at packages/main/src/core/dirty-worktree-gate.ts:40-50. If one of those synchronous git calls hangs, Node cannot run the Promise.race timeout or heartbeat callbacks, and the call is not converted into DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError. This violates CHK-002/M2: every heartbeating closeout phase must fail closed by an independent attributed phase deadline below the global idle watchdog. Patch/bound execSync or remove it from the wrapped closeout path and add smoke coverage for an execSync git hang.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 3f8c62469: done_prepare closeout phase deadline wrapper now patches both execFileSync and execSync, restores both in finally, syncs builtin ESM exports, and the focused smoke covers a doneClosure execSync git hang failing closed under the phase deadline.

findings.desc: done_prepare closeout hard deadlines still do not cover all production synchronous child-process work after the merge-main refresh. runCloseoutPhase wraps buildDoneClosureRunbook at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1246-1258 and installs installCloseoutPhaseChildProcessDeadline at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:502-559, but that installer only replaces childProcess.execFileSync / synced ESM named exports. buildDoneClosureRunbook reaches buildDoneChecklist at packages/main/src/handlers/done-closure.ts:165-179, and that path imports and calls execSync directly for git probes including checkMainDivergence (packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:66-70), related-doc diff (packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:575-581), and readGitStatusLines (packages/main/src/core/dirty-worktree-gate.ts:40-47). A hung execSync blocks the event loop, so the Promise.race timer/heartbeat cannot fire and the child-process deadline wrapper never converts it to DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError. The focused smoke passes for the execFileSync hook, but it does not inject or cover an execSync git hang; patch/restore execSync too or move these closeout probes onto the bounded execFileSync path and add smoke coverage for that case.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 3f8c62469: done_prepare closeout phase deadline wrapper now patches both execFileSync and execSync, restores both in finally, syncs builtin ESM exports, and the focused smoke covers a doneClosure execSync git hang failing closed under the phase deadline.

findings.desc: agent:"lattice-review-concept" Round 4 smoke still does not prove the doneClosure execSync hang path from F-004. The new done-closure case sets LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_SMOKE_SYNC_GIT_HANG_PHASE=doneClosure in packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:411-417, but installCloseoutPhaseChildProcessDeadline applies that smoke hook to both execFileSync and execSync in packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:543-587. In the production doneClosure path, buildDoneClosureRunbook calls buildDoneChecklist at packages/main/src/handlers/done-closure.ts:165-179, and buildDoneChecklist first calls captureEvidenceHashSnapshot at packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:276-281. That snapshot reads git status with execFileSync before the execSync probes: packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts:178-185 and :151-156. Therefore the smoke times out on a doneClosure execFileSync call before it can reach readGitStatusLines execSync in packages/main/src/core/dirty-worktree-gate.ts:40-47 or checkMainDivergence/related-doc execSync in packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:66-70 and :575-581. This leaves the requested F-004 regression evidence uncovered; add a smoke that bypasses or separately targets the earlier execFileSync probes and forces a doneClosure execSync git call to hang under the phase deadline.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 91a6d07ea: the done_prepare smoke hook now distinguishes execFileSync vs execSync with LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_SMOKE_SYNC_GIT_HANG_KIND, and the doneClosure regression sets execSync-only so earlier execFileSync probes cannot satisfy the test. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke, and npm exec --yes --package typescript -- tsc -p packages/main/tsconfig.json --noEmit.

findings.desc: Quality regression blocker: the Round 4 doneClosure execSync smoke does not actually force a production execSync git probe to hang. LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_SMOKE_SYNC_GIT_HANG_PHASE=doneClosure is consumed by installCloseoutPhaseChildProcessDeadline for both execFileSync and execSync, and buildDoneClosureRunbook reaches buildDoneChecklist, which first calls captureEvidenceHashSnapshot/readMaterialDirtyFiles via execFileSync before readGitStatusLines/checkMainDivergence/related-doc execSync probes. The smoke can therefore pass by timing out the earlier execFileSync path, leaving the F-003/F-005 execSync regression evidence unproven. Add coverage that bypasses or separately targets the earlier execFileSync probes and demonstrates a doneClosure execSync git hang is converted to DonePreparePhaseTimeoutError under the phase deadline.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 91a6d07ea: the done_prepare smoke hook now distinguishes execFileSync vs execSync with LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_SMOKE_SYNC_GIT_HANG_KIND, and the doneClosure regression sets execSync-only so earlier execFileSync probes cannot satisfy the test. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke, and npm exec --yes --package typescript -- tsc -p packages/main/tsconfig.json --noEmit.

findings.desc: Wrapping done_required_validate in runCloseoutPhase is not fail-closed for async validation commands. runCloseoutPhase races the handler deadline at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1233, but runDoneRequiredValidation awaits runValidationCommand at packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:531 and writes done-required-evidence.json at packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:587. Because runValidationCommand owns an independent child timeout at packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts:429 and receives no abort signal, a phase timeout returns DONE prepare BLOCKED while the child continues and can later write PASS DONE-required evidence. Verified with a temp fixture: LATTICE_DONE_PREPARE_DONE_REQUIRED_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT_MS=100, a DONE-required node command sleeping 1000ms, done_prepare returned blockedAt validate, then done-required-evidence.json appeared afterward with status PASS. This violates timeout/error mapping and fail-closed semantics; cancel/abort the DONE-required run or prevent evidence writes after the phase deadline before wrapping it.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit d30173a65: done_prepare passes abort/deadline control into DONE-required validation; validation-executor kills the child process on abort; runDoneRequiredValidation checks deadline before commands, after command completion, and before writing done-required-evidence.json. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke, including a delayed DONE-required command that times out and cannot late-write PASS evidence.
